name: io.github.jonathanrreed/apple-files-mcp
title: Apple Files
description: Inspect and manage local files and folders inside allowed roots on macOS.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_FILES_MCP_SAFETY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safety mode for file operations: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_FILES_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directories the server may access. Defaults to Desktop, Documents, Downloads, and iCloud Drive.
